verdict.rationale: The Guichet unique docs explicitly recognize mandataires (representatives) and déclarants filing formalities on behalf of clients. They also describe a payment-delegation mode that lets a mandataire pass the filing fee to the client company, so a third-party representative rail plainly exists in the product. However, the evidence only touches this rail in the payment context and never documents how a representative is authorized, proves its mandate, or is linked to the company account. Missing for 10: documented mandate/authorization process for representatives, rules on who qualifies as a sanctioned mandataire, account-level delegation or role management for acting on a company's behalf, independent corroboration.
